name: qlrisk_price_prime_brokerage
title: Price a PrimeBrokerage
description:
Price one Prime Brokerage Agreement (qlrisk PrimeBrokerage).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, terms, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, day_count.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 0.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
